name: Case Keenum
issue: Overrated: a journeyman spot-starter rated 90 (elite) off one strong season.
root_cause: Volume passing stats with no efficiency/quality floor scored as generated_high_confidence — the engine read raw yards/TDs as elite without grading rate or sustained quality.
fix_applied: Engine now applies a volume-vs-efficiency floor; finalized with a curated override pinning his career-best 2017 to a strong-starter grade.
rating_reason: Career-best 2017 (13-3 Vikings) was a strong-starter season, not elite; otherwise a journeyman spot starter.

name: Quenton Nelson
issue: Underrated: a multi-time First-Team All-Pro guard rated 72 (generic band).
root_cause: Interior OL has no offensive box-score line, so with no stat signal the pre-fix engine dropped him onto the low-confidence 67-71 fallback like an anonymous lineman.
fix_applied: Position-specific OL grading (no longer dependent on box scores) plus a curated override; override re-derives blank attributes from the new overall so the vector matches an elite guard.
rating_reason: Multiple-time First-Team All-Pro guard; one of the NFL's premier interior offensive linemen.

name: Sam Howell
issue: Overrated: a replacement-level first-year starter rated 91 (elite).
root_cause: Same volume trap as Keenum — league-leading pass attempts produced big raw totals that scored high-confidence, while a league-high sack count and heavy turnovers were not penalized.
fix_applied: Engine volume/turnover/sack penalties added; curated override pins him to a replacement-level starter grade.
rating_reason: High-volume but turnover- and sack-prone first full season; a replacement-level starter, not a star.

name: T.J. Watt
issue: Underrated: a perennial All-Pro / former DPOY edge rusher rated 73 (generic band).
root_cause: Edge/defense had no offensive box-score evidence, and an injury-shortened 2022 (10 games) thinned his stat line, so the pre-fix engine parked him on the low-confidence fallback.
fix_applied: Position-specific edge grading on a per-game basis plus a curated override (pass_rush 99, tackling 92, strength 90); override re-derives the rest of the vector from overall 95.
rating_reason: Perennial All-Pro and 2021 Defensive Player of the Year; elite edge rusher (2022 injury-shortened but dominant per game).
